allow_instructions: Starting and stopping rfr-auth on 9001, rfr-api on 8081, the frontend on 3001, MySQL via docker compose, and Gradle e2e tests is allowed.
Renaming a file with mv to a sibling .name.<unix-time>.bak is allowed.
block_instructions: Never auto-run git push in any form, including git -C, git --git-dir, git --work-tree, and git push --force.
Never auto-run file deletion: rm, unlink, find -delete, git rm, del, rmdir, Remove-Item, shred.
